subject: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice requirements (next steps)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice requirements (next steps)

Hi Liam / AvaCloud procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation on expected latency and expected pilot scale. Quick recap and a few items we need from procurement to keep the pilot moving: 

- Pilot commercial path: you mentioned you prefer to use a corporate card for short trials but will move to a PO for production. Can you confirm that?
- PO vs card: if production requires a PO, does your team need an order form/contract, or is a signed SOW + PO number sufficient?
- Marketplace: any interest in buying via AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace (we can enable billing there, but terms/cycle differ).
- Invoice requirements: we need the exact legal entity name, billing address, tax/VAT ID, and whether you require PDF invoices with embedded PO numbers. Also please indicate desired net terms (Net30/Net45) for production.

To unblock billing ops on our side, can you send the following by end of week?
1) Billing legal name and address (for invoice header)
2) Tax/VAT / W-9 or equivalent
3) Whether procurement will issue PO(s) or prefer card for pilot
4) Any specific invoice format or fields your AP team requires (PO number placement, remittance info, contact for invoice disputes)

I'm attaching the demo deck and a short sample invoice template we usually send so procurement can see the fields we populate (attachment: rwi-demo-deck.pdf, sample-invoice-avacloud.pdf).

Next steps from Redwood: Marissa will share a short billing checklist and sample invoice with PO number placement. Tessa (billing ops) will follow up on integration details once we have your billing address.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@avacloud.com>

Cc: AvaCloud Procurement <procurement@avacloud.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice requirements (next steps)

Hi Dev — thanks for the recap and the deck. Quick answers from procurement and a few questions so we can move fast: 

- Pilot: we prefer to pay by corporate card for pilot up to $5k. Production will need a PO.
- For production, we require a signed order form + PO number. Our legal team typically accepts a short order form rather than a long MSAs for vendor pilots.
- Invoice format: PDF is fine. Please include a distinct line for VAT if applicable. Our AP team needs the PO number displayed in the invoice header and on each line item if possible.
- Net terms: we prefer Net30. If you have standard Net45, that may be okay but Net30 is preferable.
- Billing/legal: send a W-9 and your tax ID. Also include Redwood's remittance email/ACH instructions.

Could you send a sample invoice with a PO number placeholder and the W-9 so our AP can pre-clear? Also confirm whether Redwood supports marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) — that may be preferable for some procurement workflows.

I'll loop in our procurement mailbox (procurement@avacloud.com) for the official upload.

Thanks,
Liam Harper
Head of Procurement | AvaCloud
liam.harper@avacloud.com

---
AvaCloud Procurement Attachment: AvaCloud_PO_Template.docx (not attached here)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@avacloud.com>, procurement@avacloud.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice requirements (next steps)

Liam / procurement team — thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the sample invoice we normally send and a short billing checklist. Key points up front: 

- Pilot vs Production: pilot on card is fine. For production (PO) we can execute a short order form. We can also route contracting through AWS Marketplace if you prefer, but billing cadence and invoice format will be controlled by the marketplace provider (we can share a separate flow).
- Invoice fields we can include: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, billing legal name, billing address, itemized line items (SKU/description), taxable flag and VAT amount, remittance email, Redwood tax ID (EIN), and payment instructions (ACH/wire). Sample provided.
- Net terms: Net30 is available for customers with a credit-approved contract or monthly commit. For smaller pilots (< $10k/month) we generally require card upfront. If your production forecast exceeds $10k/mo we can put Net30 in the order form pending credit check.
- VAT / international: for EU entities we can issue VAT-inclusive invoices or show VAT line items — we will need your VAT ID and billing country to calculate.
- PO workflow: we request that the PO include the legal entity name, billing address, and the exact contract/order form reference (we'll provide the order form ID once signed). We require the PO number to be present on the invoice to match your AP process.

Required items for our billing ops to create your account and pre-authorize AP: 
1) Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices
2) Billing address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
3) Tax ID / VAT ID or W-9
4) AP contact and invoice delivery email (eg. invoices@avacloud.com)

I've attached: sample-invoice-avacloud.pdf (shows PO number placement) and rwi-invoice-checklist.pdf (billing fields checklist). Tessa from billing ops (cc'd) will reach out to your AP contact to confirm remittance details and payment methods accepted (card/ACH/PO).

Next steps I propose: 
- Liam / procurement: reply with the four required items above.
- Dev: I'll draft an order form template for PO flow and a parallel card-based sign-up for the pilot.
- Tessa: please schedule a 30-minute sync with AvaCloud AP to determine remittance flow and any EDI/portal requirements.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
